heading: SECTION 1
description: This standard lays down performance requirements of Lighting and Lightsignalling devices for Agricultural tractors and Construction Equipment Vehicles (CEVs).

heading: SECTION 5
description: On and from 24 months from date of implementation of AIS-199, Test Agency shall not grant approvals to AIS-010 (Rev.1) (Part 1, 2, 4 and 5), AIS-012 (Rev.1) (Part 1), AIS-012 (Rev.1) (Part 3) and AIS-127, as applicable. On and from 24 months from date of implementation of AIS-200, Test Agency shall not grant approvals to AIS-057 (Rev.1), AIS-022, AIS088 (Rev.1), AIS-089 (Rev.1) and AIS-090 (Rev.1), as applicable. On and from date of implementation of AIS-199, Test Agency shall not refuse to grant extensions of approval to AIS-010 (Rev.1) (Part 1, 2, 4 and 5), AIS-012 (Rev.1) (Part 1), AIS012 (Rev.1) (Part 3) and AIS-127, as applicable. On and from date of implementation of AIS-200, Test Agency shall not refuse to grant extensions of approval to AIS-057 (Rev.1), AIS-022, AIS-088 (Rev.1), AIS-089 (Rev.1) and AIS-090 (Rev.1), as applicable.

heading: SECTION 6
description: As an exception to 7.4 of AIS-037, (or related administrative decisions) for certifying compliance of 'E'/'e' approved Lighting and Light Signaling devices to this standard, the test as per relevant clause of the relevant standard shall be carried out by testing agency

heading: SECTION 7
description: Acceptance of changes in ECE regulations after the level described in para 0.3 of introduction shall be as per AIS-000, as amended from time to time, as applicable, unless otherwise stated in this standard.
